phase_name: Red-baseline spike - prove both fixtures exercise the check

objectives.description: Build both fixture PDFs in scratch dir (TextWriter for binder chars)
Run each through literature-convert.sh with LITERATURE_CONVERTER=pymupdf, capture exit code and stderr
Record exit code, raw glue count, and gate reason strings for each fixture
Confirm both fixtures RED (exit 3), raw counts >=3, sole reason is sentence-boundary-glue
Confirm negative fixture residue after exemption strip is 0, positive fixture residue >=3

approaches_tried.approach: Long single insert_text() line spanning >90 chars at fontsize 10
approaches_tried.reason: PyMuPDF insert_text() does not wrap; a line wider than the page's usable width is silently truncated mid-word, which nearly hid the intended fusion boundary in the positive fixture. Fixed by keeping each insert_text() line under ~70 chars.
